d:
Bihar men mausam ka mijaj badalne ke sanket mil rahe hain. mausam vigyan kendr, patna ki or se jari purvanuman ke mutabik, 20 navanbar ko rajy ke jyadatar hisson men mausam shushk rahne ki sanbhavna hai. isi bich janie tuphan akvan ka kitna hoga asar
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
